discription: An introductory synthdef using a pulse wave, an ADSR envelope, and a resonant low-pass filter to create a basic, slightly rich tone. It features two slightly detuned pulse oscillators for a thicker sound.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, rq=0.5, cutoff=4000; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.01, 0.3, 0.7, 0.5, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); var osc1 = Pulse.ar(freq); var osc2 = Pulse.ar(freq * 1.005); sig = (osc1 + osc2) * 0.5; sig = RLPF.ar(sig, cutoff, rq); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
